info.name: Full-Stack E-Commerce API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the NovaCart e-commerce REST API.

Setup:
1. Import this collection and the `ecommerce-api.postman_environment.json` environment.
2. Set BASE_URL (default http://localhost:4000/api/v1).
3. Run 'Auth > Login as Admin' and 'Auth > Login' to capture tokens automatically.
4. Seed variables: run 'Products > Create Product (Admin)' and 'Users > Create Address' to populate PRODUCT_ID / ADDRESS_ID.

Demo accounts:
  Admin    → admin@novacart.dev / Admin@1234
  Customer → customer@novacart.dev / Customer@1234
